text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite everything that happened, Daitaku Helios managed to bounce back thanks to her besties.
Ahead of the final major showdown of the year, the Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Yeeeeaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Everrryone,
bow down and worship meeeeee!!" your

text_block_list.name: Friends
text_block_list.text:
Wheeeeeew!!
We are not worthyyyy!!!!

text_block_list.name: DJ
text_block_list.text:
Let's hear it again for today's event!
Are you all enjoying "The Birth of the Mile King Helios! Yoicho!"?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyy~!!

text_block_list.name: DJ
text_block_list.text:
"Welcoming our guest, the goddess—no, the Mile King
who achieved consecutive victories in both the Mile CS
and Yasuda Kinen, Daitaku Helios—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Make some noise
for me, everyoneeee♪

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text: Aaaaayyy!!

text_block_list.name: Friends
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get what's going on,
but congrats, Helios~~!!
choice_data_list: (It really is an incredible feat, though...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just winning each of those races is amazing on its own,
but achieving back-to-back victories in all of them...
It's truly a historic feat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Normally, there should be a much bigger commendation
from the URA, and in fact, there will likely be
an invitation soon, but..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, Trainy-poyo, dance too!
Hyah~☆
choice_data_list: (Well, as long as Helios is having fun, that's what matters most.)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hold on a secooond!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh!?
A secret guest appearance?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"No!
I... No, WE!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna slam a challenge right in the face
of the current Mile King!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"—Everyone gathered here,
follow my lead!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Bamboo Memory's lead, everyone
present followed along, andâ

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it's Zephyr!
Wait, everyone's here!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Good day, Ms. Helios.
You are wrapped in a hot wind today as well.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You're late, Helios!
I was just killing time playing soccer~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Other top-tier Umamusume seem to have gathered as well.
Including Bamboo Memory, what they all have in common is—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
One more person was supposed to come, though...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Friends
text_block_list.text:
...!?
It's Oguri Cap!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There were food stalls that smelled so good...
It slowed me down a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap... Even Daitaku Helios's friends, who don't seem
to know much about racing, appear to recognize her immediately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "A legendary Umamusume who caused that much of a sensation across the world... And if she has come here, that means—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-senpai, what's up! ☆
Wait, what is with this bizarre lineup?!
choice_data_list: So you're settling who the true Mile King is.
So you're settling who the true Mile King is.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehh~~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Me! Me, me-me-me!
It's gotta be me, right!?!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Then please... show us for real what true royal presence looks like!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh~~!!
Trainy~?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: What's that, sounds crazy fun☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, I'm so in~~!
No one parties harder at the mile than me!!

text_block_list.name: Friends
text_block_list.text:
I dunno what's happening, but it looks fun!
Go for it, Helios~ Waaaay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, a mile showdown suddenly began under a relaxed mood. A race gathering top-tier Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Bwahahahahahaaa!!
Hit 'em haaaard!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmph...! As if I'd let you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The entire audience could only hold their breath...
Showcasing sheer, overwhelming power,
she tore through the short 1,600m distance.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyyyyy~!
That was super duper fun~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my heart leaped as well.
You run in a fascinating way, Helios.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: 'Preciate it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, why is everyone
silently freaking out!?"

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text: ...Helios is so super cool~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wah!?

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
"She's not just our rowdy homie!
Mad respect... She's a legit king!!"

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
All hail~~!!
We are not worthy~~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"What is this!
...Total hype!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"If they're gonna put me on their shoulders anyway, I need to make them
truly want to carry me from the bottom of their hearts."
choice_data_list: Could it be to show everyone how amazing Helios is?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Of course, going head-to-head was what I wanted
most. But...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Helios ain't an emperor with no clothes! That's 'cause... we got mad respect for her.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Aaaayy♪
Come on everyone, more, moooore!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Praise me~☆
Party-girl Mile King is simply the best~♪"
